title: Nixon-Haldeman Smoking Gun tape

tellings.quote: whole Smoking Gun when you look at the Smoking Gun conversation on the 21st of June that with halman uh in Nixon on the tapes that uh that halderman comes into the office and says uh Mr President I think we've got a problem here

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, points Michels to the 1972 White House tape known as the "Smoking Gun" conversation, which he places on 21 June, between President Nixon and his chief of staff H.R. Haldeman. As Sheehan tells it, Haldeman comes into the office and says, "Mr President I think we've got a problem here." Sheehan reads the tape alongside the roles of FBI chief Pat Gray, CIA officials Vernon Walters and Richard Helms, and Nixon aide John Ehrlichman, as proof of what lay behind Watergate.
